clues.text: Noah was 600 years old when this came upon the earth.
For forty days it kept coming on the earth, lifting Noah's ark high above the ground.
In Noah's day, its waters covered even the highest mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
God told Noah that when the rainbow appears, He will remember His promise that this will never again destroy all life.
Noah lived 350 more years after this, dying at the age of 950.
Jesus said that before this, people were eating, drinking and marrying, unaware until it swept them all away.
Peter wrote that God brought this on the ungodly ancient world but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among eight.
